<thought>To calculate DBE for C14H13O5, use the standard formula DBE = (2C + 2 - H)/2 (oxygen ignored). Plugging in C=14, H=13 gives (28+2-13)/2 = 17/2 = 8.5. Since the required answer format is an integer, we round to the nearest whole number, yielding 9.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
